**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Validate workflow-run scoping fields before filtering**

When a readback contains an older successful run and a newer in-progress run whose `repository` metadata is missing, this filter silently discards the newer run and accepts the older success. `_trang_du` validates IDs and pagination but does not reject the incomplete run. I reproduced this through the CLI by appending run 101 with `status="in_progress"` and no `repository` to the existing `r834` baseline: `accept` returned 0 and saved `state="accepted"` using run 100. Validate the workflow-run scoping fields before filtering so incomplete evidence cannot bypass the latest-run requirement.
